title: Cyanobacteria Total Lipid Extraction
author: Dr. Steven Wilhelm
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ibkcakw

steps.title: Prepare water‑saturated butanol
steps.instruction: Mix equal volumes (1:1 v/v) of butanol (Fisher Scientific Catalog #71-36-3) and lab‑purified water to obtain water‑saturated butanol.

steps.title: Prepare lipid extraction solvent
steps.instruction: Combine solvents by volume in a 15:15:5:1:0.18 ratio: 95 % ethanol (Fisher Scientific Catalog #BE-BDH1156), water, diethyl ether (Fisher Scientific Catalog #60-29-7), pyridine (Fisher Scientific Catalog #110-86-1), and 4.2 N ammonium hydroxide (Fisher Scientific Catalog #7664-41-7). Mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Collect cyanobacterial culture
steps.instruction: Grow cultures to log phase, then collect 2 mL into a 2 mL microfuge tube (minimum 500 µL required). For liquid environmental samples, skip the growth step and use the sample directly.

steps.title: Optional: Fix aliquot for cell counts
steps.instruction: Remove 100 µL of culture, add 5 % (v/v) glutaraldehyde (prepared from 25 % stock) to fix cells for later counting, and store the fixed aliquot at 20 °C.

steps.title: Pellet cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at 10,000 × g for 2 min; discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet in extraction solvent
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL of the extraction solvent (prepared in Step 2) to the pellet and resuspend.

steps.title: Add glass beads
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of 150 µm glass beads (pre‑weighed in a 1‑dram vial) to the tube.

steps.title: Vortex sample
steps.instruction: Vortex vigorously for 5 seconds.

steps.title: Incubate at 60 °C
steps.instruction: Place the tube in a 60 °C water bath for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Centrifuge sample
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 10,000 × g for 10 minutes in a benchtop microcentrifuge.

steps.title: Collect supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to a glass vial; all extractions from the same sample will be combined in this vial.

steps.title: Repeat extraction without extra beads
steps.instruction: Repeat Steps 6–11 (add extraction solvent, vortex, incubate, centrifuge, collect supernatant) but do **not** add additional glass beads.

steps.title: Add water to pellet
steps.instruction: Add 150 µL of water to the remaining pellet in the microfuge tube.

steps.title: Add butanol phase
steps.instruction: Vigorously shake the water‑saturated butanol (1:1) to mix, then add 300 µL to the tube.

steps.title: Vortex after butanol addition
steps.instruction: Vortex for 5 seconds.

steps.title: Collect butanol phase
steps.instruction: Remove the top butanol layer and add it to the same glass vial containing previous extracts.

steps.title: Repeat butanol wash
steps.instruction: Repeat Steps 13–16 once more (add water, add butanol, vortex, collect butanol).

steps.title: Dry or store extract
steps.instruction: Dry the combined extract under a stream of nitrogen for LC‑MS analysis, **or** store the vial overnight at –20 °C, or for long‑term storage at –80 °C.

steps.title: Prepare extraction solvent for filter
steps.instruction: Prepare a fresh batch of extraction solvent as described in Step 2.

steps.title: Cut Sterivex filter into pieces
steps.instruction: Using a Sterivex cutter and a sterile razor blade, cut the filter out of the Sterivex unit, chop it into small pieces, and place them into a 2 mL microfuge tube.

steps.title: Resuspend filter in extraction solvent
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL of extraction solvent to the tube and resuspend the filter pieces.

steps.title: Add glass beads to filter
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of 150 µm glass beads to the tube.

steps.title: Vortex filter suspension
steps.instruction: Vortex very vigorously for 5 seconds to keep filter pieces from settling.

steps.title: Incubate filter at 60 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube in a 60 °C water bath for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Centrifuge filter suspension
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 10,000 × g for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Collect filter supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to a glass vial (same vial may be used for multiple extractions).

steps.title: Repeat filter extraction without extra beads
steps.instruction: Repeat Steps 21–26 (add extraction solvent, add beads, vortex, incubate, centrifuge, collect supernatant) **without** adding more glass beads.

steps.title: Add water to filter residue
steps.instruction: Add 150 µL of water to the tube containing the residual filter material.

steps.title: Add butanol to filter residue
steps.instruction: Vigorously shake water‑saturated butanol (1:1) and add 300 µL to the tube.

steps.title: Vortex filter mixture
steps.instruction: Vortex the mixture.

steps.title: Collect butanol from filter
steps.instruction: Remove the top butanol layer and add it to the glass vial with previous extracts.

steps.title: Repeat butanol wash for filter
steps.instruction: Repeat Steps 28–31 once more (add water, add butanol, vortex, collect butanol).

steps.title: Dry or store final extract
steps.instruction: Dry the final combined extract under nitrogen for LC‑MS, or store at –20 °C overnight, or at –80 °C for long‑term storage.
